---
description: "Review a bounded project change adversarially."
---

Read the task-routed authorities, inspect the actual diff and current tests, and
report correctness, ownership, compatibility, regression, and evidence gaps in
severity order. Review only an integrated candidate declared frozen; if
material edits are still in progress, report that it is not ready. After fixes,
close the reported findings directly and repeat the full review only if the
acceptance surface changed. Cite real files. Do not invent issues or restate
the change.
